summary: Final read-only review of the T3/T4/T5 repair against source files, tests, and job logs.
final_report:
CHANGES REQUIRED. The final repair has concrete defects: static/sage-workspace.html addMessage() inserts loaded message content directly into innerHTML, and both static/sage-workspace.html and static/index.html render marked output without an HTML/XSS safety boundary; persisted or provider-supplied HTML/event-handler payloads can execute. The stop button CSS in both chat pages declares `grid` instead of `display:grid`, and the send flow clears the inline display value while the stylesheet still says display:none, so the user cannot reliably expose the stop control during generation. Home first-turn session creation in static/index.html runs outside the try/finally cleanup path and does not check the POST response, so a failed create can leave streaming locked and still attempt a turn with a null/invalid session id. SSE partial persistence is incomplete: app/services/sessions/session.py defines persist_partial_content(), but app/services/sessions/turn.py never calls it while consuming deltas; a disconnect or provider error therefore leaves only an empty partial marker and reload loses already streamed assistant text. run.sh comments out both dependency-install commands and then invokes .venv/bin/uvicorn, so a fresh environment can fail to start; it also enables --reload unexpectedly. The final title fix in static/sage-workspace.html has only analyzer_pending in .agents/jobs/T5_title_fix.json; the only Merlin run (.agents/jobs/T5_verify.json) predates that fix and explicitly failed the document-title assertion, so the final state is not browser-verified. That run expected `Sage - <title>` while the final source assigns `Sage — <title>`, so the separator contract also needs alignment. T3, T4_fix, T5, and T5_title_fix all still have empty committed_at values despite status done; their logs therefore do not meet the required provenance convention for this uncommitted shared workflow. README.md still says API-only/no web UI and omits the actual static tree and root route, so its structure and architecture diagrams are inaccurate. Route ordering in app/main.py is otherwise aligned: API routers precede the root StaticFiles mount, and the successful T5 evidence confirms one create/one turn, persistence, reload restoration, title endpoint, and delete cleanup. python -m pytest -q passed 298 tests; no final standard verify_ui.mjs run is recorded because the known Playwright resolution blocker remains. Verdict: CHANGES REQUIRED.
